REResults

Reliance posts record Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,62,268 crore (up 27.8%) and PAT of ₹29,550 crore (up 33.8%).

Record profits are driven largely by a volatile oil-refining boom, while Jio's listing cut debt and Retail profits are shrinking, so the quality of this growth needs watching.

▲ Positive · High ✓ earnings inflection · earnings impact high

RELIANCE₹1,165 · MCap ₹1,576,405 Cr · EPS ₹55.22 · PEG 3.2 · Exchange filing, read by AI · Fri 30 Oct, 7:43 PM Read ↗

Consolidated revenue ₹3,62,268 crore, up 27.8% Y-o-Y; EBITDA ₹62,409 crore, up 23.9%.

Profit after tax ₹29,550 crore, up 33.8%; 1H FY27 PAT crosses ₹50,000 crore.

Oil-to-Chemicals EBITDA jumped 67.9% to ₹25,203 crore on fuel and petrochemical margins.

Jio Platforms IPO raised ₹30,188 crore; ₹27,500 crore used to prepay Jio's foreign borrowings.

JPResults

Jio Platforms Q2 FY27 consolidated profit after tax ₹8,387 Cr on revenue of ₹40,475 Cr for quarter ended Sep 30, 2026, up about 8% QoQ.

Large, profitable telecom and digital company now listed; the IPO proceeds are cutting debt, which strengthens the balance sheet, though the stock is far too large to be a small-cap opportunity.

NAResults

New India Assurance posts half-year loss of about ₹3,191 lakh (~₹32 Cr) after tax, with a qualified auditor review.

The insurer swung to heavy losses with a qualified audit review and large unprovided tax demands, which is a clear risk to earnings and governance.

Why It Moved

Every session since Apr 2024: was the rise knowable before the open, or chance? Tests chosen on data before Jul 2025, checked after

Of every liquid stock that beat the median by 5%+ in a session since 2025-07-01 (13,644): 5% validated before the open · 24% news during the session · 18% news before the open, no proven edge · 53% nothing on record. When a validated test fired before the open the stock was 3.19× as likely as any stock to be such a mover. 37 tests/pairs held up (luck alone gives 2).

Honest check — 10 picks a session from tests chosen on data before 2025-07-01 only, scored after it (330 sessions): average +0.89 vs the average stock, beat the median stock 55%, +3 or more 22.6%. Live since this desk began (2 sessions, 20 picks): -0.61, 40% ahead.
